name: Weather Classification
description: Let your setup act on the weather it sees: clear, cloudy, foggy, rainy or snowy conditions drive greenhouse vents, awnings, irrigation and outdoor gear automatically — weather-aware automation without a weather station.
description_zh: 让设备自己看天做事：识别晴/多云/雾/雨/雪，联动温室通风、遮阳、灌溉和庭院设备，天气一变自动响应——不装气象站，也能按天气自动化。
author: Seeed Studio
